scope: Same learned mixture and frozen parent, one fixed training-only relative cohort loss experiment
calibration: Artificial frame zero in the existing corpus only; excluded from motion observations and targets
holdouts: Old and v19-added validation are both exposed development data. Freeze weights before loading either in this experiment. All gates pass independently on old/new/combined before any of the six sealed confirmation clips may open.
label_policy: Only four known poses (or two without context) enter observations; full targets are separate trainer labels
physics_policy: Collapsed semantic edges are not asserted to have constant length; raw baselines do not qualify actual rig physics
next: Evaluate selected compatible predictions on actual-rig editable actions; failed gates forbid promotion
selection: One prospectively fixed 50/50 combination of original equal-cohort and inverse-error cohort mass. No grid, parent retraining, validation selection or tuning.
reproduction: Repeat complete gate fit and development evaluation; model, weights, parent membership, expert strengths and non-runtime report must match.
runtime: Local NumPy float64; previously bounded public data acquisition complete; no runtime downloads or external services
projection_method: Fixed 48-step projected Adam with eight bounded quarter-step backtracking attempts; exact root, terminal orientations and known priorities
fold_group: CMU catalog prefix before underscore, not asserted to be independent actor identity
objective: Keep original trajectory and derivative Gram loss. Compute mean position MSE per procedural control per training cohort; use the smallest of those three cohort means. Half of total loss weight is original equal-cohort mass; half is normalized inverse baseline error, floored at1% of the median positive training-cohort error. Divide each cohort mass equally across its windows. Feature normalization remains original equal-cohort weights. No labels or error weights enter inference.
architecture: Unchanged v21 548-input,32-hidden-unit,four-softmax position gate with frozen v20 rotations and learned expert. Inference is the exact same v21 function and serialization format.
stationary_acceptance: Identical observed endpoints/context yield exactly zero raw residual. Near-stationary residual approaches zero continuously. Actual stationary rig positions/orientation matrices remain within existing 2e-5 host numerical tolerance across generated frames, including source recovery.
control_policy: Retain original projected linear/Hermite and add projected shape reference. Every ratio and worst-cohort check compares against the best of all three; thresholds remain identical. This prevents procedural improvements from being presented as learned-motion gains.
rotation_policy: Frozen v20 rotations; do not blend rotation representations.
fold_policy: Reconstruct the exact four v20 catalog-prefix folds. Each gate-training row uses the parent model excluding its whole catalog group. The gate itself sees all training labels; no nested cross-validation or independent gate-generalization claim.
guard_policy: Convex positional blending bounds each predicted coordinate by expert values. This does not guarantee quality versus the best expert. Six fresh confirmation clips stay absent until unchanged development gates pass.
